decisions.reason: After moving from a simple mention to a dedicated page, this identity-related service fits the firm’s strategy of integrating GeoIT with enterprise systems, so management would keep the option open while market potential continues to clarify.

The framework still appears only lightly marketed, which suggests slower commercial proof, but as a reusable base for client solutions its strategic option value likely still exceeds the cost of keeping it available.
Its stronger 2024 presentation and close fit with customer demand for linking GIS applications to existing user-management systems make it a strong candidate to remain on the market.
A newly launched consulting workshop is relatively cheap to maintain, can generate follow-on project work, and after only one year the firm would typically wait for more evidence before dropping it.
